traits.leaf_arrangement.note: NZ Flora, Gleicheniaceae (read 2026-10-16): fronds single from a creeping rhizome; same in Dipteridaceae and Matoniaceae (our knowledge).

traits.rosette.note: NZ Flora, Gleicheniaceae (read 2026-10-16): creeping rhizome, fronds spaced along it; scrambling indeterminate fronds (Gleicheniaceae is about 140 spp., nearly all the order).

traits.leaf_division.note: NZ Flora, Gleicheniaceae (read 2026-10-16): pinnae forked one or more times, with leaflets; Matonia pedately divided; Dipteris deeply cut fan (one blade, stated simple).

traits.life_span.note: NZ Flora, Gleicheniaceae (read 2026-10-16): rhizomatous ferns with indeterminate fronds.
